caption:
Hooked on tennis or pickleball? Here's what clinical Pilates can add to your game 🎾

Both sports ask for quick side-to-side footwork, controlled rotation and shoulders that handle repeated serves. Pilates trains those qualities with spring resistance that's easy to adjust: single-leg control for your lunges, trunk rotation for your groundstrokes and shoulder strength through range.

Most players find one or two sessions a week fits well, placed away from big match days. The program can shift when you're playing more or managing a niggle.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio starts with an assessment and builds a program around your sport. Book online via the link in bio.
